title: Career Sessions (James Lowry, PathWise) — 'Most companies don't fail because they're outcompeted. They fail because they succeed.'
summary: James (J.R.) Lowry — C-level executive, founder of PathWise.io, Career Sessions host — releases a launch-week episode titled 'Why Success Can Destroy A Company,' framing Incorruptible as a manifesto on how too much capitalism has become a bad thing.
blockquote: Most companies don't fail because they're outcompeted. They fail because they succeed.
attribution_title: Podcast hosted by James (J.R.) Lowry — C-level executive, founder of PathWise.io
